profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: Experienced Operations Manager with a demonstrated history of working in the hospitality industry. I have 15+ years of experience in restaurant hospitality and have worked through various concepts.

positions.title: Assistant General Manager
positions.description:
Assisted with New Concept Development (Operations-Focused). 
Conducted mass hiring efforts utilizing different platforms (Seasoned, Poached, Indeed, Glassdoor). 
Created & Coordinated New Restaurant Training Program for all departments (Server, Bar, Gaming, Hosts, & Server Assistants) in a classroom style setting. 
Creation & Implementation of New Hire Onboarding Process (HR Checklists, Orientation, Training Material, & Training Schedule).
Coordinated inaugural implementation of Point of Sale program (Toast). 
Created Daily, Weekly, & Monthly checklists & manuals for all gaming equipment maintenance (Brunswick Bowling Lanes, Lyrical Karaoke Systems, MBS Mechanical Bull).

positions.title: Operations Manager
positions.description:
AOR- 
Support staff (Host & Activities) Scheduling & Maintenance + ordering utilizing a period-to-period declining budget.
FOH Service Scheduling for a venue of 22K Sq. Ft. utilizing the Hot Schedules Management Tool.
Daily use of Gather: Event Management Software, for scheduling and processing payments for private events. 
Fluent in Aloha POS FOH & BOH administrative options. 
Daily use of daily manager logbook: ShiftNote 
Utilized Compeat Restaurant Software for deposits and invoices.

Adhere and enforce EcoSure Food Safety and Public Health procedures.

positions.title: New Restaurant Opening- Manager
positions.description:
Interviewed and hired support staff in city-wide job fair setting.

Actively trained FOH staff in a classroom setting.

Daily relocating FOH staff memebers to maximize coverage based on zone service

Participated as closing manager for a new restaurant Grand Opening in high volume setting.
